verification_level: FAST plus BATCH; three repairs (one pointer-validity repair, one safety-contract correction, one fallible-arithmetic guard). No STOP remains open.
scope: Per-file contract audit of seven EVP/FFC units plus the FFC private-key generator: the two RSA-only legacy pkey wrappers, the legacy set1/get0/get1 assign helpers, the engine remainder of p_lib.c, the seven pmeth_check entry points, the FFC provider import bridge, and FFC private-key generation. method_store.rs was deferred again as the method-store registry boundary; ffc/key_generate.rs was substituted from the head of the stable queue.

defects.class: mutable descriptor pointer derived from immutable storage
defects.description: EVP_PBE_scrypt_ex built the four numeric OSSL_PARAM descriptors with `&n as *const u64 as *mut u64` over immutable parameters. OSSL_PARAM_construct_uint64 publishes a `*mut u64`, so a provider that writes the parameter would write through a pointer derived from a shared borrow (undefined behaviour under Stacked Borrows). The in-tree SCRYPT decoder only reads these parameters, so today's path is not observed to write.
defects.fix: The four scalars are now `mut` parameters and the descriptors use `core::ptr::addr_of_mut!`, so the published pointer is derived from mutable storage. The `mut` parameter patterns do not change the exported signature or ABI.
defects.witness: Compile and code review. A runtime control would need a provider that writes an input parameter; no in-tree provider does (NOT_RUN).

defects.class: safety contract weaker than the body's requirement
defects.description: ossl_ffc_params_fromdata documented `ffc` as 'NULL or a live, writable FFC_PARAMS', but the body unconditionally dereferences `(*ffc)` for gindex/pcounter/h and both set0 calls. A caller relying on the stated contract could pass NULL and cause UB. The same contract also omitted that DIGEST/DIGEST_PROPS UTF8 data is stored by pointer, not copied.
defects.fix: The `# Safety` section now requires a live, writable, non-NULL `ffc`, and states that DIGEST/DIGEST_PROPS data must outlive the object (authority-faithful borrowing). No code change.
defects.witness: Documentation-only; the four ffc::backend tests pass unchanged.

defects.description: ossl_ffc_generate_private_key computed `2 * s` twice on `c_int` values without a bound. The authority's expression is signed overflow (undefined); the debug port panicked and the release port wrapped. The wrapped path for s = c_int::MIN reaches BN_priv_rand_range_ex with range 1 and the `priv >= M` loop never terminates. Every current in-tree caller passes MIN_STRENGTH or ossl_ifc_ffc_compute_security_bits (at most 1200), so the path is not reachable today.
defects.fix: Compute the doubled strength once with `checked_mul(2)` and refuse on overflow, before any allocation or shift. Recorded as the AGENTS.md section 17 divergence from the authority's undefined expression.

contracts_reused: OSSL_PARAM terminated-array and caller-owned output-buffer contract (params arrays are frames' own; key/keydata extents are the caller's)
KDF provider input-parameter convention: set_ctx_params reads input descriptors and copies password/salt into its own clear-free-owned buffers; it does not write the caller's parameter buffers
EVP_PKEY_CTX provider/legacy discrimination: `-1` from try_provided_check means 'not a provider context' and is never an invalid-key answer
Refcount set1 contract: up_ref before EVP_PKEY_assign, free the acquired reference only when the assignment refuses
FFC_PARAMS ownership contract: set0_pqg/set0_j take ownership with NULL and same-pointer no-ops; the authority err label frees j, p, q, g in that order
BIGNUM secret-output convention (B19): generation writes the private key directly into the caller's BIGNUM; releasing/cleansing that BIGNUM remains the caller's obligation
RC-1 allocator seam and #[repr(C)] layouts: untouched by this batch
residuals: src/evp/method_store.rs remains deferred as the method-store registry boundary.

pmeth_check.rs uses PMETH_CHECK_78 (OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_THIS_KEYTYPE) for both the EVP_PKEY_NONE test and the not_supported label. The authority raises NO_KEY_SET at the NONE test. Both statements sit in the legacy arm, which is unreachable in this crate because try_provided_check returns -1 only when ctx->keymgmt is NULL and no legacy context can be built; no code change was made because the exact authority coordinate for that raise is not available in this checkout (authority differential NOT_RUN).
ffc/backend.rs stores DIGEST and DIGEST_PROPS as borrowed pointers (the authority does the same); the obligation is now explicit in the safety contract and remains the caller's.

pbe.rs does not cleanse the caller-owned `key` output on a failed derive; the authority does not either and the buffer belongs to the caller. No internal secret buffer exists in this unit (password/salt are only pointed at by descriptors; the provider copies them into its own clear-free-owned storage).

p_dec/p_enc write caller-owned plaintext/ciphertext buffers and keep no internal copy; p_lib/pmeth_check borrow private keydata without copying it; ffc/backend handles public parameters. No new cleansing obligation was introduced by this batch.

ffc/key_generate.rs writes the private key directly into the caller's BIGNUM. DH key generation releases its temporary with BN_clear_free; dsa/key.rs keygen_err uses BN_free, which is the authority's own ordering (noted as a follow-up outside this batch, not repaired here).
No constant-time claim is made for any unit in this batch; no secret-dependent branch or comparison was introduced.
